_comment: Effective PyQSOFit UV/optical config; the executable is configs/pyqsofit/uv/main.py.

uncertainty.mode: covariance by default; optional MC resampling and emcee MCMC

mcmc.initialization_fix: configs/pyqsofit/uv/mcmc_support.py: bounds-aware, strictly positive walker state supplied as lmfit pos; model/priors unchanged
mcmc.root_cause: lmfit p0=(1+1e-4*N(0,1))*value gives identically zero columns for free amplitudes whose MLE is exactly at the lower bound (undetected [S II] lines); emcee rejects the state with 'Initial state has a large condition number'
mcmc.recipe: PYQSOFIT_MCMC=1 PYQSOFIT_NSAMP=300 PYQSOFIT_NBURN=80 PYQSOFIT_NTHIN=1 PYQSOFIT_NWALKERS=100 PYQSOFIT_MCMC_SEED=20240517 PYQSOFIT_MCMC_LINE_SAMPLES=500
mcmc.documented_status: 04592649654_z_0.5874: a 300-step run completed the fit in 1400.6 s but its chains were not copied by the timed-out outer shell. The committed MCMC CSV/npz/corner/trace are from the validated 10-step (8 retained, 100 walkers) initialization-fix run and are explicitly non-converged; the 100-realization MC remains the committed uncertainty product.
